items.q: How do timesheets turn into invoices?
items.a: Your team logs hours against projects and tasks. Once a manager approves them, Odoo turns approved hours into draft invoices at the rates you agreed with the client. The exact billing rules we confirm in the Blueprint.

items.q: Can Odoo handle retainers and milestone billing?
items.a: Yes. Odoo supports fixed-price, milestone and time-and-materials billing, and recurring invoices for retainers. Which mix fits your contracts, we confirm in the Blueprint.
Contractor rates, timesheets, invoices and payouts run in one flow with our contractor module, so nobody pays contractors from email threads. We map your payout rules in the Blueprint.

items.q: Can we keep our payroll provider?
items.a: Yes. Payroll can stay with your current provider. We agree with your accountant how payroll entries reach the books, and confirm the details in the Blueprint.
